# VC-HB-2810

The manufacturer is G&G.
The type code is 501-302-0515.
The description is 10B-2, with 15 teeth, and with taper bush 1210.
This idler reuses the drive sprocket solid.
It has no second STEP file.
The URL is https://www.gg-powertransmission.com/fileadmin/cad/kettenraeder-klemmbuchsen/duplex/cad_501-302-0515.zip

- The file used is `cad/vendor/VC-HB-2800/501-302-0515.stp` (520232 bytes).
- The file starts with `ISO-10303-21`.
- The download date is 2026-11-19.
- The terms are a public direct download and no account.
- You must check the terms of the manufacturer before you send this file to other persons.

The orientation is the same as VC-HB-2800.
`load_vendor_shape("VC-HB-2800")` recenters the file.
`Rot(90, 0, 0)` maps the bore onto Y.
The assembly places the idler on the same axis, at Z = 1551 mm.
That position is 36 mm above the profile ends.
The tooth tip is about 82.7 mm.
